transcript:
Alice: Quick kickoff — we need a short sprint to align copy across Hosted API, Dedicated, and Private pages before the benchmark webinar next Wed. Goal: 3 hero variants + one unified CTA + routing plan for webinar leads.
Ben: +1. Do we keep the technical focus for Dedicated/Private and conversational benefit for Hosted? :thinking_face:
Clara: yes, Dedicated/Private should lead with SLAs, isolation, and deployment modes. Hosted hero should be about "fast time-to-value" and easy onboarding.
Morgan: Also want an explicit benchmark blurb on each page that links to the webinar: "See latency & cost benchmarks in our upcoming webinar" — that drives signups.
Sam: I'll mock 3 hero art directions today. Do we want different CTAs (Start free / Request demo / Schedule private evaluation) or one CTA that branches by cookie?
Alice: One primary CTA text on page but route by query param. Example config — we can use UTM or a tiny routing script:

```
if (utm_source === 'webinar') route = '/signup?flow=hosted';
else if (org_size === 'enterprise') route = '/sales-demo';
else route = '/signup';
```

Ben: Love that. For copy, keep the top line 6–8 words. Subheadings can be mode-specific bullets: throughput, compliance, private deployment.
Clara: Sample hero lines: Hosted: "Ship LLM features faster — API-first inference." Dedicated: "Predictable throughput, reserved capacity." Private: "VPC and on-prem inference for regulated workloads."
Morgan: For the webinar CTA, can we append `?utm_campaign=benchmark-webinar` and capture product interest (hosted/dedicated/private) in a hidden field in the form?
Sam: Yep. I'll add hidden field options: product_interest: [hosted,dedicated,private].
Alice: Copy owners: Ben — Hosted + form microcopy. Clara — Dedicated/Private tech bullets and SLA section. Morgan — webinar blurb and routing logic. Sam — visuals and CTA treatments. Deadline = EOD Friday for first pass.
Ben: I'll drop a short copy doc in the marketing drive and ping for review.
Morgan: I'll update inbound routing spec for sales: webinar signups with product_interest=private go to AE queue, dedicated->solutions eng, hosted->self-serve nurture. Will add in the doc.
Clara: Need a one-liner for benchmark page: "Benchmarked on real-world prompt mixes: latency, cost, and tail P99s — see how we compare." Keeps it credible.
Sam: Sharing Figma link in #design. I'll create three hero frames and label them Hosted/Dedicated/Private.
Alice: Great. Quick checkpoints Friday 10am. If anyone is blocked, flag in this thread. :rocket:
